import math
import unittest
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError

from solution import Reading, collect_readings


def snapshot(offers, requests, value):
    return {"offers": offers, "requests": requests, "value": value}


class CollectReadingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_computes_imbalance_and_change_in_order(self):
        snapshots = [
            snapshot([[100, 2], [101, 3]], [(99, 7)], 10),
            snapshot([(100, 1)], [[99, 4], [98, 2]], 15),
            snapshot([], [], 0),
            snapshot([], [], 5),
        ]
        result = collect_readings(snapshots, 10, 100)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            Reading(2.0, 10.0, None),
            Reading(5.0, 15.0, 50.0),
            Reading(0.0, 0.0, -100.0),
            Reading(0.0, 5.0, None),
        ])
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            result[0].value = 2

    def test_stops_before_threshold_snapshot(self):
        data = [
            snapshot([], [[1, 2]], 10),
            snapshot([], [[1, 3]], 20),
            snapshot([], [], 30),
        ]
        result = collect_readings(data, 10, 3)
        self.assertEqual(result, [Reading(2.0, 10.0, None)])

    def test_max_points_limits_consumption(self):
        def source():
            yield snapshot([], [], 1)
            yield snapshot([], [], 2)
            raise AssertionError("iterator consumed past max_points")

        result = collect_readings(source(), 2, 10)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)

    def test_zero_max_points_does_not_consume_input(self):
        class ExplodingIterable:
            def __iter__(self):
                raise AssertionError("must not consume snapshots")

        self.assertEqual(collect_readings(ExplodingIterable(), 0, 1), [])

    def test_empty_input_and_input_non_mutation(self):
        self.assertEqual(collect_readings([], 3, 1), [])
        data = [snapshot([[1, 2]], [[2, 4]], 7)]
        offers = data[0]["offers"]
        requests = data[0]["requests"]
        before = repr(data)
        collect_readings(data, 1, 10)
        self.assertEqual(repr(data), before)
        self.assertIs(data[0]["offers"], offers)
        self.assertIs(data[0]["requests"], requests)

    def test_parameter_validation(self):
        for maximum in (-1, 1.5, True, "1"):
            error = ValueError if maximum == -1 else TypeError
            with self.subTest(maximum=maximum):
                with self.assertRaises(error):
                    collect_readings([], maximum, 1)
        for stop, error in [(-1, ValueError), (math.inf, ValueError), (math.nan, ValueError), (True, TypeError), ("1", TypeError)]:
            with self.subTest(stop=stop):
                with self.assertRaises(error):
                    collect_readings([], 1, stop)

    def test_structural_errors(self):
        bad = [
            {"offers": [], "requests": []},
            {"offers": [], "requests": [], "value": 1, "extra": 2},
            {"offers": (), "requests": [], "value": 1},
            {"offers": [[1]], "requests": [], "value": 1},
            {"offers": [[1, 2, 3]], "requests": [], "value": 1},
            {"offers": ["ab"], "requests": [], "value": 1},
            {"offers": [[1, True]], "requests": [], "value": 1},
            {"offers": [], "requests": [], "value": True},
        ]
        for item in bad:
            with self.subTest(item=item):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    collect_readings([item], 1, 10)

    def test_invalid_numeric_values(self):
        bad = [
            snapshot([[math.inf, 1]], [], 1),
            snapshot([[1, math.nan]], [], 1),
            snapshot([[1, -0.1]], [], 1),
            snapshot([], [[1, -1]], 1),
            snapshot([], [], math.inf),
        ]
        for item in bad:
            with self.subTest(item=item):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    collect_readings([item], 1, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
